Message:
I can’t believe it...!
To think there’s a witch
harboring all the Curses
plaguing the world
inside herself...!

If such a thing can be done,
then the answer must be...!

No, even for an angel,
is a plan of that scale
even possible?

To start with,
Curses were created by demons,
using the powers of Qlipha
as their foundation...

Wait... Going back even further,
the origins of Curses
lie with the Tree of Life...

In other words,
harboring a Curse in one’s body
is the same as recreating
the Tree of Life itself...!

If that person were to keep
taking in Curses,
then one day, they could...!

I see...! That certainly would
count as a rebellion!

Ahh...! This is the first time
I’ve felt such exhilaration...!

I thought this world was
nothing but an utter bore,
but it seems I must reevaluate.

Giving such color
to my existence
deserves a fitting
display of gratitude.

I won’t let
this world be destroyed.
How could I ever let
all of this end?

After all, I still need to verify
if my answers are true, don’t I?
